summary: Implemented the canonical Phase ID parser defined by CPIPC-001 v1.0 (src/pcae/core/phase_id.py: parse, is_valid, normalize, format, validate, scan_tokens, find_first_token, match_leading_token, equals, compare, same_series, same_branch, the immutable PhaseId value, and the closed nine-kind PhaseIdError/ErrorKind taxonomy) and migrated nine of the ten CPIPC-001 Section 14 consumer groups (all fifteen originally inventoried call sites except one deliberate, documented exception) to it: report title extraction, commit-subject scanning, and branch-aware comparison in core/phase_reports.py; PROJECT_STATUS.md current-phase extraction in core/check.py; parse_phase_id/ordering/freshness in core/architecture_status.py; bootstrap ambiguity detection and TODO.md staleness in core/context.py; the duplicated _TSA_*/_SIT_* helpers in core/agent.py; cltr_prototype/identity.py and cltr_prototype/compatibility.py; phase-queue validation and commit-message phase-range expansion in commands/phase.py; done-task phase extraction in commands/push.py; and core/repository_transition_integration.py's parse_phase_id_from_text, the one consumer CPIPC-001 Section 13 flagged as still carrying an unrepaired truncation defect at contract-freeze time. Every duplicate Phase ID regex/grammar/comparison implementation in the migrated set was removed outright, including the exact-duplicate literal pair (check._PHASE_CODE_RE / agent._TSA_PHASE_CODE_RE). Deliberately deferred: cltr/authority/identity.PhaseIdentity (an opaque wire-format/charset boundary type bound to identity.schema.json, not Phase ID grammar; Phase 137P Section 15's charset-reservation risk remains open) -- recorded in docs/CANONICAL_PHASE_ID_PARSER_MIGRATION.md and tasks/DECISIONS.md. Runtime remained Observed / observe / unavailable throughout.
tests_added_or_updated: Added tests/test_phase_id.py (62 tests) covering the frozen grammar (supported/reserved/invalid forms), normalization/case-insensitivity, canonical representation semantics, comparison semantics (numeric subphase ordering, branch rollover including the non-lexical AA>B case, exceptional-branch exclusion, no-artificial-total-ordering), the closed error taxonomy, token scanning, and dedicated historical regression tests replaying the 137F.1V, 137MV.1, and 113X.3 defects CPIPC-001 exists to foreclose. Updated three existing tests that asserted internals of since-removed local regexes (tests/test_phase_136ay_lifecycle_bootstrap_independent_verification.py, tests/test_commit_attribution_repair_134e10_1_1.py) to assert the equivalent behavior of the still-public extraction functions instead, and one legacy test (tests/test_architecture_status_generation_independent_verification_134e8v.py) that asserted the pre-migration single-letter subphase-suffix cap, updated to assert the CPIPC-001-mandated widening with an explanatory comment.
